item.title: A lot of buses that are connected(seeking greenlights)
item.content:encoded:
page type: an SCP item

narrative: A lot of buses, one for every country, all linked on the inside. It is possible to walk from one to another and they constantly rearrange. Every hour, one of them becomes the main front bus, and begins driving on his own. They have the outside appearance of regular buses, complete with a driver. Some of them have an advertising space on them, that will produce ads for whatever has been inside the bus.

catch: A quick way for the foundation to move around the globe with minimal effort.
